content: भुज् I. €6 <ab>P.</ab> (भुजति, भुग्न) .²1 To bend. .²2 To curve, make crooked. --II. €7 <ab>U.</ab> (भुनक्ति-भुङ्क्ते, भुक्त) .²1 To eat, devour, consume (<ab>Ātm.</ab>); शयनस्थो न भुञ्जीत <ls>Ms. 4. 74</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">3. 146</ls>; <ls>Bk. 14. 92</ls>; हत्वार्थकामांस्तु गुरूनिहैव भुञ्जीय भोगान् रुधिरप्रदिग्धान् <ls>Bg. 2. 5</ls>. .²2 To enjoy, use, possess (property, land <ab>&c.</ab>); संप्रीत्या भुज्यमानानि न नश्यन्ति कदाचन <ls>Ms. 8. 146</ls>; <ls>Y. 2. 24</ls>. .²3 To enjoy carnally (<ab>Ātm.</ab>); सदयं बुभुजे महाभुजः <ls>R. 8. 7</ls>, <ls n="R.">4. 7</ls>, <ls n="R.">15. 1</ls>, <ls n="R.">18. 4</ls>; सुरूपं वा कुरूपं वा पुमानित्येव भुञ्जते <ls>Ms. 9. 14</ls>. .²4 To rule, govern, protect, guard (<ab>Paras.</ab>); राज्यं न्यासमिवाभुनक् <ls>R. 12. 18</ls>; एकः कृत्स्नां (धरित्रीं) नगरपरिघप्रांशुबाहुर्भुनक्ति <ls>Ś. 2. 16</ls>. .²5 To suffer, endure, experience; वृद्धो नरो दुःखशतानि भुङ्क्ते <ls>Sk.</ls> .²6 To pass, live through (as time). .²7 (In <ab>astr.</ab>) To pass through, fulfil. --{%<ab>Pass.</ab>%} .²1 To be enjoyed or eaten. .²2 To be possessed. .²3 To be brought under the influence of. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} (भोजयति-ते) To cause to eat, feed with. --{%<ab>Desid.</ab>%} (बुभुक्षति-ते) To wish to eat <ab>&c.</ab>

भुज् {%a.%} .²1 (At the end of <ab>comp.</ab>) Eating, enjoying, suffering, ruling, governing; स्वधाभुज्, हुतभुज्, पाप˚, क्षिति˚, मही˚ <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 Useful, serviceable. --{%f.%} .²1 Enjoyment. .²2 Profit, advantage.
